Name: Serpent's Blood
Effect: Randomly restores 1-25 HP

Name: Shield Potion
Effect: Generates a shield equivalent to lost HP, up to 50.

Name: Holy Water
Effect: Randomly Removes one curse.

Name: Reforge Potion
Effect: Reforges all spells in the inventory. Note, this is only spells in the Backpack, not on wands.

Name: Illusion Potion
Effect: Slows down time for 12 sec.

Name: Awakening Potion
Effect: Temporarily increases MP regenration for your wands by 200% for 10 sec.

Name: Refresh Potion
Effect: Refreshes purchasable items and accessible doors in all rooms.

Name: Lockpick Potion
Effect: Unlocks all locked objects in the current room. Note, can be used to safely open a cursed chest without receiving the curse.

Name: Midas Potion
Effect: Transforms all non-boss enemies in the room into coins.

Name: Discount Potion
Effect: Applies a discount to all purchasable items in the current room.

Name: Levitation Potion
Effect: You're levitating!  Lasts until you enter the next door.

Name: Invisibility Potion
Effect: Grants invisibility for 12 sec; attacks won't reveal you.

Name: Invincibility Potion
Effect: Grants invincibility for 8 sec.

Name: Petrification Potion
Effect: Petrifies yourself, granting immunity to all DMG for 30 sec but you are unable to fire wands.  Movement will end Petrification.

Name: Agility Potion
Effect: Permanently increases movement speed by 0.6.

Name: Scale Potion
Effect: Permanently alters your body size.

Name: Crystal Potion
Effect: Permanently increases MP regenration by 1.

Name: Unstable Red Potion
Effect: Permanently increases Max HP by -5 or 15.

Name: Unstable Blue Potion
Effect: Permanently increases Max MP by -5 or 15.

Name: Purification Potion
Effect: Removes all curses.  Lose all coins, keys, and shield.

Name: Wealth Potion
Effect: Gains coins equal to 25% of the coins currently in possession.

Name: Tears Of the Goddess
Effect:
Removes all curses if 5 different curses are present.
Note: counts curse symbols, not curses acquired.

Name: Relic Potion
Effect: Randomly upgrades one relic.  If no relic can be upgraded, receive a common relic.

Name: Reset Potion
Effect:
Resets one chosen relic.
Note: you choose the relic, not the game.

Name: Sacrificial Potion
Effect: Deducts 20% of current HP to gain a corresponding amount of coins.

Name: Locksmith Potion
Effect: Doubles current key count or adds 1 keys if none are owned.

Name: Pure Castor Oil
Effect:
Grants immunity to poison and slime in the current room.  Inflicts poison and slows enemies behind for 10 sec.
Note: Potion will cause you to move towards the cursor for the 10 seconds of damaging enemies.

Name: Duplication Potion
Effect: Duplicates all HP recovery, shield, coin, and keys from the current room.

Name: Treasure Potion
Effect: Obtains a random treasure chest.

Name: Emergency Potion
Effect:
Grants a temporary shield equivalent to your lost HP.
Note: The temporary shield goes away when entering the next room.

Name: Conversion Potion
Effect: Deducts 40% of current HP to gain a corresponding amount of shield.
